# Agent Proving Mission

Capability ID: agent-proving-mission-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/agent-proving-mission-v1/index.html
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- test my AI agent
- evaluate an AI agent
- prove agent reliability
- agent benchmark mission
- AI worker competency test

## Problem

Teams can demo an agent but struggle to prove what it can reliably do under a bounded mission with evidence and review.

## Inputs

Agent/workflow under test, bounded mission, success criteria, allowed tools/environment and authority boundaries.

## Outputs

Mission criteria, observed attempts, competency evidence, decision traces and concise pass/gap report.

## Pricing

Current hypothesis $250-$2,500 per proving mission; not auto-quotable yet.

## Invocation and authority

Discoverable capability; paid execution verification pending.

Testing scope and external side effects require explicit authority. Paid execution requires confirmed terms and payment.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
